Ellie: Quick heads-up — onboarding starlark-7b (int4) shows token-level differences vs fp16 on punctuation and EOS. Minimal repro below, any quick checks?

Omar: paste repro + diff pls.

Ellie: repro:
python eval.py --model starlark-7b --quant int4 --prompt "Hello, world!" --seed 42

FP16: Hello, world!
INT4:  Hello , world !
(extra spaces around punctuation; EOS probs differ)

Sasha: smells like tokenizer index shift or rotary scale mismatch. Did conversion add placeholder tokens or change vocab ordering?

Matt: check tokenizer.special_tokens_map and try `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('starlark-7b'); print(t.encode('!'))"`

Ellie: ran token check: '!': 33, '.': 13, '': 50256 — weird, converter injected an empty sentinel at 50256.

bench-bot: perf snip: int4 starlark-7b ~48ms/token, ppl +0.9 vs fp16 on evalset-v1.

Sasha: if high-id sentinel exists, KV cache aliasing can misapply rotary phases for those ids. Try conversion flag --preserve-token-ids or run scripts/fix_vocab_map.py --strip-placeholder.

Omar: I'll bisect rotary_scale (1.0,1.2,1.4) and check per-head phase alignment. Want me to run on dedicated pool?

QA-Jen: also run scripts/compare_logits.py --fp16 pathA --int4 pathB --tokens 256 --report topk to see whether mass is redistributed vs whitespace tokenization.

Ellie: thanks — doing strip-placeholder now and requesting bisect. Filing ticket T1234 and assigning @Omar @Sasha. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
